images.observation: Front retains original brick front/left tower walls, cream low hall, deep green-grey entry/window backs and dark bars. Curved balcony returns continuous cream; broad roofs, coping, steps and base neutral. No text, overlays or clipping.

Top view retains all broad roof fields, roofbox, tower coping, entry walking surfaces and base neutral. Only exposed narrow curved solid parapet rim carries cream; no glass inserted into the balcony or new geometry/overlays.

Matched original rear clearly shows formerly neutral independent tower walls; final rear extends brick to these genuine exteriors and cream to the narrow hall side. Artificial low rear cuts, roof fields, coping, original window backs and all geometry stay unchanged.
